title: Hydrophobic covalent organic frameworks: a green synthesis approach for efficient oil/water separation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4768-4773
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08201J, Paper
Open Access

Bilian Li, Quanmei Duan, Lishen Yang, Tan Feng, Chang Ru, Xin Zhang, Hui Zhao, Can-Peng Li
The rapid economic development has led to oil pollution and energy shortages. In this paper, a hydrophobic covalent organic framework of COF-AG was synthesized rapidly at room temperature, which has high oil–water separation performance.
